title: TurnOffTheLight
bio: A dark, club-inspired rework blending elements of 'ICON' and 'True Icon', 'TurnOffTheLight' reimagines the anthemic energy of JinnaWoods’ original material through an edgier electronic lens. It also references Kim Petras’ 'Turn Off the Light', from which it borrows inspiration and attitude.
